newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK weather - cloudy with light rain patches.
newsitem.headline: HK weather - cloudy with light rain patches.

text.p: The weather will be cloudy with light rain patches and there will be sunny intervals during the day, the Royal Observatory said on Tuesday.
The maximum temperature will be 29 C with moderate gusty northeasterly winds.

The strong Monsoon signal was hoisted, winds with mean speed of 41 to 62 kilometres per hour are expected from the northeast. At 7 a.m., the temperature was 25 C and the relative humidity was 84 percent.
